zou2022eccconsensus.title: Expert consensus on early childhood caries management
zou2022eccconsensus.why: Konsensus ahli terbaru soal etiologi, penilaian risiko, pencegahan, dan tata laksana ECC; sering dipakai sebagai rujukan utama definisi ECC.

maklennan2024eccglobal.title: A systematic review and meta-analysis on early-childhood-caries global data
maklennan2024eccglobal.why: Angka prevalensi ECC global terbaru (dengan analisis subkelompok); sumber data kuat untuk bab pendahuluan.

chen2021eccpolicies.title: Oral Health Policies to Tackle the Burden of Early Childhood Caries: A Review of 14 Countries/Regions
chen2021eccpolicies.why: Perbandingan kebijakan ECC di 14 negara/region (termasuk Asia); berguna untuk argumen kebijakan kesehatan gigi anak di Indonesia.

gao2021sdfpolicy.title: Global Oral Health Policies and Guidelines: Using Silver Diamine Fluoride for Caries Control
gao2021sdfpolicy.why: Peta kebijakan pemakaian SDF di berbagai negara; menjawab 'apakah SDF sudah masuk pedoman resmi?'.

ruff2023cariedaway.title: Effect of Silver Diamine Fluoride on Caries Arrest and Prevention: The CariedAway School-Based Randomized Clinical Trial
ruff2023cariedaway.why: RCT besar berbasis sekolah: SDF menahan dan mencegah karies pada anak; bukti level tertinggi untuk efikasi SDF.

zheng2022sdftherapy.title: Silver diamine fluoride therapy for dental care
zheng2022sdftherapy.why: Ringkasan mekanisme, indikasi, efek samping (diskolorasi), dan protokol aplikasi SDF; pegangan praktis klinisi.

banihani2022mid.title: Minimal intervention dentistry for managing carious lesions into dentine in primary teeth: an umbrella review
banihani2022mid.why: Payung dari banyak systematic review: membandingkan tumpatan konvensional vs teknik minimally invasive pada gigi sulung.

duggal2022eapddeepcaries.title: Best clinical practice guidance for treating deep carious lesions in primary teeth: an EAPD policy document
duggal2022eapddeepcaries.why: Panduan resmi EAPD untuk lesi karies dalam pada gigi sulung: kapan selective removal, kapan pulpotomi, kapan ekstraksi.

hu2022halltechnique.title: Hall technique for primary teeth: A systematic review and meta-analysis
hu2022halltechnique.why: Bukti tingkat tinggi bahwa Hall technique (SSC tanpa preparasi) efektif menahan karies gigi sulung.

lygidakis2022mihpolicy.title: Best clinical practice guidance for clinicians dealing with children presenting with molar-incisor-hypomineralisation (MIH): an updated European Academy of Paediatric Dentistry policy document
lygidakis2022mihpolicy.why: Dokumen paling banyak dikutip di seluruh daftar ini (254 sitasi); panduan MIH resmi EAPD versi terbaru.

lopes2021mihprevalence.title: The prevalence of molar-incisor hypomineralization: a systematic review and meta-analysis
lopes2021mihprevalence.why: Angka prevalensi MIH dunia + faktor geografis; data dasar untuk rumusan masalah prevalensi.

somani2022mihtreatment.title: An update of treatment modalities in children and adolescents with teeth affected by molar incisor hypomineralisation (MIH): a systematic review
somani2022mihtreatment.why: Komparasi modalitas terapi MIH (desensitisasi, sealant, restorasi, SSC, sampai ekstraksi) beserta kekuatan buktinya.

shekhar2022distraction.title: Effect of active and passive distraction techniques while administering local anaesthesia on the dental anxiety, behaviour and pain levels of children: a randomised controlled trial
shekhar2022distraction.why: RCT distraksi aktif vs pasif saat anestesi lokal; desain mudah direplikasi untuk skripsi klinis.

kohli2022behavior.title: Psychological behavior management techniques to alleviate dental fear and anxiety in 4-14-year-old children in pediatric dentistry: A systematic review and meta-analysis
kohli2022behavior.why: Meta-analisis teknik psikologis (tell-show-do, modeling, distraksi) penurun kecemasan anak usia 4-14 tahun.

du2022vr.title: A digital intervention using virtual reality helmets to reduce dental anxiety of children under local anesthesia and primary teeth extraction: A randomized clinical trial
du2022vr.why: RCT distraksi VR (headset) pada ekstraksi gigi sulung; topik teknologi yang sedang naik.

ashley2021sedation.title: Best clinical practice guidance for conscious sedation of children undergoing dental treatment: an EAPD policy document
ashley2021sedation.why: Standar EAPD untuk sedasi sadar: pemilihan obat, monitoring, dan aspek safety pada anak.

wikstrom2021immature.title: What is the best long-term treatment modality for immature permanent teeth with pulp necrosis and apical periodontitis?
wikstrom2021immature.why: Perbandingan apexifikasi, revaskularisasi, dan MTA apical plug untuk gigi imatur nekrosis; sering jadi rujukan kasus endo anak.

laforgia2025trauma.title: Paediatric dental trauma: insights from epidemiological studies and management recommendations
laforgia2025trauma.why: Epidemiologi trauma gigi anak plus rekomendasi tata laksana terkini; terbit 2025, datanya segar.

galler2021resorption.title: Pathophysiological mechanisms of root resorption after dental trauma: a systematic scoping review
galler2021resorption.why: Mekanisme patofisiologi resorpsi akar pasca trauma (permukaan, inflamasi, penggantian); dasar prognosis kasus trauma.

pakkhesal2021ohrqol.title: Impact of dental caries on oral health related quality of life among preschool children: perceptions of parents
pakkhesal2021ohrqol.why: Menghubungkan skor karies dengan OHRQoL anak prasekolah menurut persepsi orang tua; instrumennya bisa ditiru.

omara2021fourdim.title: Four-dimensional oral health-related quality of life impact in children: A systematic review
omara2021fourdim.why: Kerangka 4 dimensi OHRQoL anak (gejala, fungsi, psikologis, sosial) + instrumen pengukurannya.

jalevik2022mihfear.title: Can molar incisor hypomineralization cause dental fear and anxiety or influence the oral health-related quality of life in children and adolescents?—a systematic review
jalevik2022mihfear.why: Jembatan antara MIH (T4) dan kecemasan dental/OHRQoL (T5, T7); bukti bahwa MIH berdampak psikososial.

ningrum2021specialneeds.title: The Oral Health Inequities between Special Needs Children and Normal Children in Asia: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
ningrum2021specialneeds.why: Data kuantitatif kesenjangan kesehatan gigi anak berkebutuhan khusus vs anak reguler di Asia (termasuk Asia Tenggara).

khan2022shcn.title: Factors affecting provision of oral health care for people with special health care needs: A systematic review
khan2022shcn.why: Faktor pasien, keluarga, klinisi, dan sistem yang menghambat pemberian layanan gigi-mulut pada pasien berkebutuhan khusus.

erwin2022autism.title: Factors influencing oral health behaviours, access and delivery of dental care for autistic children and adolescents: A mixed-methods systematic review
erwin2022autism.why: Sintesis kualitatif + kuantitatif khusus anak autistik; memperkaya bagian 'anak berkebutuhan khusus' dengan perspektif orang tua.

alshaya2022teledentistry.title: The accuracy of teledentistry in caries detection in children - A diagnostic study
alshaya2022teledentistry.why: Validitas deteksi karies anak lewat foto/teleconsultation vs pemeriksaan klinis; referensi utama teledentistry anak.

kuru2025aiTrauma.title: Can Artificial Intelligence Language Models Effectively Address Dental Trauma Questions?
kuru2025aiTrauma.why: Menguji jawaban ChatGPT dkk untuk pertanyaan trauma gigi anak; topik AI + kedokteran gigi anak, sangat fresh.

tuygunov2025aidfdi.title: The Transformative Role of Artificial Intelligence in Dentistry: A Comprehensive Overview Part 2: The Promise and Perils, and the International Dental Federation Communique
tuygunov2025aidfdi.why: Pernyataan resmi FDI (Federation Dentaire Internationale) soal AI di kedokteran gigi, termasuk janji dan risikonya pada pasien anak.

cheever2025freesugar.title: Impact of Free Sugar Consumption on Dental Caries: A Cross-Sectional Analysis of Children in the United States
cheever2025freesugar.why: Analisis data survei nasional: asupan gula bebas vs karies anak; angka aktual pembanding untuk data Indonesia.

laracastor2024ssb.title: Intake of sugar sweetened beverages among children and adolescents in 185 countries between 1990 and 2018: population based study
laracastor2024ssb.why: Data konsumsi minuman manis anak di 185 negara; konteks global (dan regional) untuk faktor risiko karies.

luo2024probiotics.title: How probiotics, prebiotics, synbiotics, and postbiotics prevent dental caries: an oral microbiota perspective
luo2024probiotics.why: Mekanisme probiotik/prebiotik/postbiotik mencegah karies (termasuk pada anak); alternatif pencegahan non-fluorida.

li2023salivary.title: Salivary microbiome and metabolome analysis of severe early childhood caries
li2023salivary.why: Profil mikrobioma dan metabolom saliva pada severe ECC; basis biologis untuk penanda risiko karies.

carvalho2026erosion.title: Dental erosion and erosive tooth wear in childhood and adolescence: from diagnosis to prevention
carvalho2026erosion.why: Terbit Agustus 2026 (paling baru di daftar ini): diagnosis sampai pencegahan erosi gigi anak; pelengkap tema karies.

vukovic2025caries12.title: Caries status in 12-year-old children, geographical location and socioeconomic conditions across European countries: A systematic review and meta-analysis
vukovic2025caries12.why: Menghubungkan status karies anak 12 tahun dengan letak geografis dan kondisi sosial-ekonomi; model analisis yang bisa ditiru untuk data Indonesia.

timms2025sdfaccept.title: Parental acceptability of silver diamine fluoride: The UK and US experiences
timms2025sdfaccept.why: Faktor penerimaan orang tua terhadap SDF (termasuk kekhawatiran diskolorasi); penting untuk konseling sebelum aplikasi SDF.

elsonbaty2025aiseg.title: Novel AI-based tool for primary tooth segmentation on CBCT using convolutional neural networks: A validation study
elsonbaty2025aiseg.why: Segmentasi otomatis gigi sulung pada CBCT dengan CNN; contoh riset AI yang benar-benar spesifik kedokteran gigi anak.

lustosa2025breastfeeding.title: Risk of Early Childhood Dental Caries Associated With Prolonged Breastfeeding: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
lustosa2025breastfeeding.why: Menjawab pertanyaan klasik klinisi: kapan menyusui berisiko terhadap karies anak; berguna untuk edukasi orang tua.

marschner2025erosion.title: Systematic review and meta-analysis on prevalence and anamnestic risk factors for erosive tooth wear in the primary dentition
marschner2025erosion.why: Prevalensi dan faktor risiko tooth wear erosif pada gigi sulung; melengkapi tema erosi (T11) dengan angka kuantitatif.
